requirements.title: C_F_STRPOINTER character-array actual restrictions
requirements.definition: The character-array form uses a rank-one, simply contiguous, TARGET actual argument of kind C_CHAR with length type parameter one.

pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-CSTRARRAY-rank-one-c-char: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0, declares CHARACTER(KIND=C_CHAR,LEN=1), TARGET :: buf(5) and passes buf; mutations use LEN=2 and rank two separately and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-CSTRARRAY-simply-contiguo: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0 and passes the whole TARGET array buf; mutation passes a strided section buf(1:5:2) or a nontarget array and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: C_F_STRPOINTER C pointer actual restrictions
requirements.definition: The C pointer form uses a scalar C_PTR INTENT(IN) value that is the C address of a contiguous sequence of NCHARS characters and is not the C address of a Fortran variable lacking TARGET.

pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-CSTRPTR-c-ptr-scalar: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0, obtains TYPE(C_PTR) :: raw = C_LOC(buf(1)) from a TARGET C_CHAR array, and passes raw; mutation passes TYPE(C_FUNPTR) and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-CSTRPTR-contiguous-nchars: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0, uses raw=C_LOC(buf(1)) for a contiguous five-element C_CHAR TARGET array and NCHARS=5; mutation derives raw from a noncontiguous section through an intermediate and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-CSTRPTR-no-nontarget-fort: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0 and derives CSTRPTR from a TARGET array; source mutation obtains the address of a non-TARGET interoperable CHARACTER(C_CHAR) variable through a BIND(C) helper returning void * and passes that C_PTR here, reaching this restriction without using C_LOC as the failing operation.

requirements.title: C_F_STRPOINTER associates FSTRPTR with the leftmost character sequence
requirements.definition: FSTRPTR is a deferred-length scalar character pointer of kind C_CHAR that becomes pointer associated with the leftmost characters of the CSTRARRAY element sequence or of the CSTRPTR target sequence.

pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-FSTRPTR-deferred-length-c: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0, declares CHARACTER(:,KIND=C_CHAR), POINTER :: fstr, and verifies KIND(fstr)==C_CHAR after association; mutation uses a fixed-length pointer and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-array-leftmost-associatio: Guarded Fortran-only plan first requires C_CHAR > 0; TARGET C_CHAR array contains ['a','b',C_NULL_CHAR,'x']; call C_F_STRPOINTER(array,fstr); assert ASSOCIATED(fstr), LEN(fstr)==2, and fstr=='ab'; mutation changes the first element to 'q' while retaining the oracle for 'ab'.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-cptr-leftmost-association: Guarded Fortran-only plan first requires C_CHAR > 0; raw=C_LOC(array(1)) for TARGET C_CHAR array ['c','d',C_NULL_CHAR,'y']; call C_F_STRPOINTER(raw,fstr,4); assert ASSOCIATED(fstr), LEN(fstr)==2, and fstr=='cd'; mutation passes C_LOC(array(2)) and the expected value changes load-bearing.

requirements.title: C_F_STRPOINTER sets FSTRPTR length from null position and NCHARS bound
requirements.definition: The FSTRPTR length becomes the largest value with no C null characters in the selected sequence, bounded by NCHARS for the C pointer form or present NCHARS, and by the CSTRARRAY size for the array form.

pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-length-stops-before-c-nul: Guarded plan first requires C_CHAR > 0, uses TARGET C_CHAR array ['h','i',C_NULL_CHAR,'j'], and asserts LEN(fstr)==2 after C_F_STRPOINTER(array,fstr); companion with ['h','i','k',C_NULL_CHAR] asserts LEN 3.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-length-bounded-by-nchars: Guarded plan first requires C_CHAR > 0, uses raw=C_LOC(array(1)) for ['m','n','o',C_NULL_CHAR] with NCHARS=2, and asserts LEN(fstr)==2, proving the NCHARS bound beats the later null; companion NCHARS=4 asserts LEN 3.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-length-bounded-by-array-s: Guarded plan first requires C_CHAR > 0, uses array form without NCHARS on a three-element array ['u','v','w'], and asserts LEN(fstr)==3; companion with a null in element 2 asserts LEN 1.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-leading-null-yields-zero-: Guarded plan first requires C_CHAR > 0, uses array [C_NULL_CHAR,'z'], initializes fstr through a previous nonempty association, then calls C_F_STRPOINTER and asserts LEN(fstr)==0 to avoid vacuity.

requirements.title: C_F_STRPOINTER NCHARS restrictions
requirements.definition: NCHARS is an optional nonnegative integer scalar INTENT(IN) argument; it is required for assumed-size CSTRARRAY and for the C_PTR form, and it cannot exceed SIZE(CSTRARRAY) for the array form.

pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-NCHARS-nonnegative-intege: Positive source control passes integer scalar 4; mutations pass -1 and [4] separately and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-NCHARS-required-for-assum: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0; subroutine dummy CHARACTER(KIND=C_CHAR,LEN=1), TARGET :: arg(*) calls C_F_STRPOINTER(arg,fstr,4); mutation omits NCHARS and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-NCHARS-required-for-cptr: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0 and calls C_F_STRPOINTER(raw,fstr,4) for raw=C_LOC(array(1)); mutation omits NCHARS and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-NCHARS-not-greater-than-a: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0 and passes a size-five array with NCHARS=5; mutation changes only NCHARS to 6 and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: C_F_STRPOINTER has no specific procedure without C_CHAR support
requirements.definition: A processor with C_CHAR equal to -1 provides no specific procedure for the C_F_STRPOINTER generic subroutine.

pending.C_F_STRPOINTER-no-specific-procedure-wit: No portable oracle can force a processor profile with C_CHAR == -1; a future profile for such a processor may compile a USE-only control and reject a C_F_STRPOINTER reference, while ordinary C_CHAR-supported processors exercise the concrete association facets.
